column1: # Gun Rack FFL Finder — ZIP → lat/lng centroid FORMAT SAMPLE.
# This tiny 10-row file is a FORMAT REFERENCE only — NOT the
# production dataset. gdffl ships without the full ~33-42k
# Census ZCTA archive because the container the tarball is
# built in cannot reach www2.census.gov (proxy policy).
# HOW TO INSTALL THE REAL DATASET (either approach works):
#   (a) ACP path — recommended.
#       ACP → FFL Finder → Import ATF CSV →
#       "Upload real Census ZCTA CSV" panel → pick the file.
#       Lands in uploads/gdffl/zip_geo.csv
#   (b) Server-disk path.
#       Drop the CSV at applications/gdffl/data/zip_geo.csv.
#       The importer's resolveZipPath() picks it up as a fallback
#       when uploads/gdffl/zip_geo.csv is missing. This sample
#       file is only used when neither of the above is present.
# CSV shape (comma-delimited; # comment lines skipped; the loader
# ignores any header row where the first column is literally
#     zip
# ZIPs are 5-digit
# (WGS-84). city and state are optional.
zip
